note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is not described; the worker description is quoted from Silvestri's original account, without specimens seen. Synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow-red; nasus red, blending with the colour of the head at the base; antennae pale cream-coloured; legs and abdomen cream-coloured; pronotum pale yellow, red-yellow anteriorly. Head generally without microscopic setae; vertex with 1 pair of longer setae (sometimes absent), base of the nasus with 1 pair, apex of the nasus with 1 pair; pronotum with short setae on the anterior margin only; abdominal tergites sparsely covered with microscopic setae, the posterior ones from tergite 5 onwards with longer setae, and in one specimen tergite 1 with an additional 1 long seta; sternites with many short and long setae. Body length 4.00–4.30 mm. Head capsule almost circular; width almost equal to the length without nasus (length with nasus 1.85–2.00, length without nasus 1.20–1.25, width 1.20–1.28 mm); in lateral view incurved, nasus hump absent. Nasus conical, very broad at the base; nasus length 0.65–0.75 mm; nasus length/head length index 0.542–0.625; apex transparent, with one or two pairs of short setae. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 about one and a half times as long as segment 2, sometimes appearing subdivided; segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 2. Mandibles reduced, each with a prominent spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.25–0.30, width 0.58–0.60 mm); anterior margin weakly concave, posterior margin slightly convex.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: No specimens seen; after the original description: head reddish brown, body straw yellow; coronal suture distinct; frontal suture anteriorly much wider than the lateral sutures; antennae and legs hazel. Body length 4.40 mm. Head slightly wider than long (head width 1.45 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 equal to segment 2, twice as long as segment 4; segment 5 longer than segment 4. Postclypeus slightly swollen. Pronotum saddle-shaped, middle of the anterior lobe weakly concave.
